    org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<byte[]>
    forward(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
    Forward a generic servlet request to catalog core, translating the path: - /api/v1/admin/ledgerly/** → /api/v1/admin/ledgerly/** (kept as-is; lives on catalog) - /api/v1/admin/zoho/** and /api/v1/admin/zoho-settings → kept as-is (catalog core) - /api/v1/** → /internal/v1/** (normal store-to-catalog internal path)
